S.FORM: ma-kaasi chiausou=maku "ma-ka-naanu alu-pa-ala=kamu mata ʔucaŋə=su?" misai ʔikua.
S.PHON: makaaʂi ʦhiausoumaku makanaanu aɾupaaɾakamu mata ʔuʦaŋəsu misai ʔikua
makaaʂi ʦhiausoumaku makanaanu a[r|ɾ]upaa[r|ɾ]akamu mata ʔuʦaŋesu misai ʔikua
S.TRANSL: My professor asked me, "What would you do to get married?"

S.PHON: miaiisua ia pakaaraʦani taanaasa ʔinia
miaiisua ia pakaa[r|ɾ]aʦani taanaasa ʔinia
S.TRANSL: At that time, my house was next door to hers.

S.FORM: mia-iisua ia, masi-raru miciko mia-iisua ia, masi-raru tara-kanaŋ ʔikua.
S.PHON: miaiisua ia maʂiraru mitʂiko miaiisua ia maʂiraru tarakanaŋ ʔikua
S.FORM: miaiisua ia, masiraru miciko miaiisua ia, masiraru tarakanang 'ikua.
S.PHON: miaiisua ia maʂi[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]u mitʂiko miaiisua ia maʂi[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]u ta[r|ɾ]akanaŋ ʔikua
S.TRANSL: At that time, Michiko naturally knew me.

S.FORM: ma-ka-uari ma-kaasi ʔikua cina-in, "ʔi-vatu-a sian k<um>aən," misai ʔikua.
S.PHON: makauari makaaʂi ʔikua tʂinain ʔivatua ʂian kumaən misai ʔikua
S.FORM: makauari makaasi 'ikua cinain, "'ivatua sian k<um>aen," misai 'ikua.
S.PHON: makaua[r|ɾ]i makaaʂi ʔikua tʂinain ʔivatua ʂian kumaen misai ʔikua
S.TRANSL: Later, her mother said to me, "Come over for a meal here."

S.FORM: kaʔan=pa=ku paki-turu mia-iisua ʔais=pa=ku ma-rainu ʔinia.
S.PHON: kaʔanpaku pakituru miaiisua ʔaispaku marainu ʔinia
kaʔanpaku pakitu[r|ɾ]u miaiisua ʔaispaku ma[r|ɾ]ainu ʔinia
S.TRANSL: At that time, I didn't agree to go because I was still shy.

S.FORM: ma-ka-uari ma-kaasi=cu cuum-in, "cu-culu=kara=kasu ma-ʔanman manu=maku?" misai
S.PHON: makauari makaaʂiʦu ʦuumin ʦuʦuɾukarakasu maʔanman manumaku misai
S.FORM: makauari makaasicu cuumin, "cucurukarakasu ma'anman manumaku?" misai
S.PHON: makaua[r|ɾ]i makaaʂiʦu ʦuumin ʦuʦu[r|ɾ]uka[r|ɾ]akasu maʔanman manumaku misai
S.TRANSL: Later, her father asked me, "Do you really like my child?"

S.PHON: kaʔanpaku maɾivaɾi
kaʔanpaku ma[r|ɾ]iva[r|ɾ]i
S.TRANSL: I still didn't reply to him.

S.PHON: ʔaispaku marainu
ʔaispaku ma[r|ɾ]ainu

S.FORM: nuura-ini masi-ʔəna-ʔəna cuum-in, "tee=kara=musu ala-ən?" misai ʔikua.
S.PHON: nuuraini maʂiʔənaʔəna ʦuumin teekaramusu aɾaən misai ʔikua
nuu[r|ɾ]aini maʂiʔenaʔena ʦuumin teeka[r|ɾ]amusu a[r|ɾ]aen misai ʔikua
S.TRANSL: The next day, her father asked me again, "Do you want to marry her?"

S.PHON: tokkiaʔai kisaənnaku
tokkiaʔai kisaennaku

S.FORM: masi-ʔəna-ʔəna ʔikua, "tee=musu-ini ala-ən ia, m-ari-avic-a ma-manu taa-tiʔiŋ m-ia-pacai kalavuŋ=aku," misai.
S.PHON: maʂiʔənaʔəna ʔikua teemusuini aɾaən ia mariaviʦa mamanu taatiʔiŋ miapaʦai kaɾavuŋaku misai
S.FORM: masi'ena'ena 'ikua, "teemusuini araen ia, mariavica mamanu taati'ing miapacai karavungaku," misai.
S.PHON: maʂiʔenaʔena ʔikua teemusuini a[r|ɾ]aen ia ma[r|ɾ]iaviʦa mamanu taatiʔiŋ miapaʦai ka[r|ɾ]avuŋaku misai
S.TRANSL: (Her father) said to me again, "If you want to marry her, you must bring (three) young men to slaughter my cow!"

S.FORM: m-ari-avici=ku ta-tulu ma-manu taa-tiʔiŋ m-ia-pacai kalavuŋ.
S.PHON: mariavitʂiku tatuɾu mamanu taatiʔiŋ miapaʦai kaɾavuŋ
S.FORM: mariaviciku taturu mamanu taati'ing miapacai karavung.
S.PHON: ma[r|ɾ]iavitʂiku tatu[r|ɾ]u mamanu taatiʔiŋ miapaʦai ka[r|ɾ]avuŋ
S.TRANSL: I brought three young men to slaughter the cow.

S.PHON: aviʦai kimia taanaasa ʔaɾamə kaɾavuŋ
aviʦai kimia taanaasa ʔa[r|ɾ]ame ka[r|ɾ]avuŋ

S.FORM: pu-ʔucipi a-pa-kaən kanakanavu, a-p-iima paʔici ma-maaraŋ.
S.PHON: puʔutʂipi apakaən kanakanavu apiima paʔitʂi mamaaraŋ
S.FORM: pu'ucipi apakaen kanakanavu, apiima pa'ici mamaarang.
S.PHON: puʔutʂipi apakaen kanakanavu apiima paʔitʂi mamaa[r|ɾ]aŋ
S.TRANSL: (We) cooked food for people and made the elders drink wine.

S.FORM: araanai=cu ʔinia alu-pa-ala=cu=kimi mata laʔəv=aku miciko.
S.PHON: araanaiʦu ʔinia aɾupaaɾaʦukimi mata ɾaʔəvaku mitʂiko
a[r|ɾ]aanaiʦu ʔinia a[r|ɾ]upaa[r|ɾ]aʦukimi mata [r|ɾ]aʔevaku mitʂiko
S.TRANSL: My wife Michiko and I have been married ever since.

S.PHON: makasua mia ʦuuʦuatʂikim
makasua mia ʦuuʦuatʂikim
S.TRANSL: Thus, we two lead our life.

S.PHON: makasua sua ʂiatuuturumaku kasua ʂienseimaku
makasua sua ʂiatuutu[r|ɾ]umaku kasua ʂienseimaku
S.TRANSL: This is what I want to tell you, sir.

S.PHON: araʂiŋʂiŋa ŋuatʂi karimaku
a[r|ɾ]aʂiŋʂiŋa ŋuatʂi ka[r|ɾ]imaku
S.TRANSL: Stay healthy! My words end here.

S.PHON: susumanpai
susumanpai
